let UnitTaxisrtree = UnitTaxis creatertree[UTrip];
query Taxis feed extend[Stretch: trajectory(.Trip atperiods [const periods value (("2023-12-12-12:00" "2023-12-12-14:00" TRUE TRUE))])] loopjoin[UnitTaxisrtree UnitTaxis windowintersects[bbox(.Trip)] {second}] consume;
